solutions.check: grid and clues read from the FT's printable PDF, its numbering matching the clue list; every fifteensquared answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Bishop feeling delicate in the morning carriage

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
feeling rough is feeling unwell, as after a heavy night
AM, ante meridiem, means in the morning

explanation.surface: A bishop with a hangover is being driven somewhere early in the day.
explanation.walkthrough: A BROUGHAM is a light, four-wheeled horse-drawn carriage with an enclosed body.
explanation.definitionFit: A brougham is a type of closed horse-drawn vehicle, so carriage is a direct synonym.

clue.text: The way to comprehensively beat Spain

parts.note: to rout an opponent is to defeat them utterly
E is the international vehicle registration code for Spain (España)

explanation.surface: A plan for thrashing the Spanish side.
explanation.definitionFit: A route is the way taken to get somewhere, a plain synonym.

clue.text: Plays down wasted student years with no end of money

indicators.note: wasted suggests something ruined or squandered, so these letters are broken up and rearranged
with no tells us to remove a letter from the word years
end of picks out the final letter of money

explanation.surface: Someone frets about years at university frittered away with nothing left in the bank.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with no end of money' removes Y from YEARS, leaving EARS; STUDENT plus EARS is rearranged to give the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To understate something is to present it as less important than it is, which is to play it down.

clue.text: Fringe around a door designed to provide enough space

indicators.note: around says the fringe word wraps about the other letters

parts.note: a hem is the edge or border of a garment, a fringe

indicators.note: designed means put together in a new form, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A border fitted round a doorway so that people can get through.
explanation.walkthrough: 'designed' rearranges A DOOR into EADROO, which sits inside HEM because of 'around'; 'to provide' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Headroom is the clearance above one's head, meaning sufficient room to move.

clue.text: Average White Band discovered here

explanation.surface: The soul-funk group Average White Band was first found in this spot.
explanation.walkthrough: Average White Band is a real Scottish band, but here the white band is the painted line down the centre of a road.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unremarkable and moderate is described as being in the centre of the road, while a white line runs down that centre.

clue.text: Opportunities to include new presenters

indicators.note: to include means the first word holds the other letter inside it

parts.note: doors, as in doors opening, are opportunities

explanation.surface: Chances arise to bring fresh faces onto the presenting team.
explanation.walkthrough: Presenters here means people who present gifts, i.e. givers, not TV hosts.
explanation.definitionFit: Donors are those who give or present something, so presenters in the sense of givers.

clue.text: Guess where grapes come from after starting to drink it

indicators.note: after places the grape plant after those opening letters
starting to takes the initial letters of drink and it

parts.note: grapes grow on a vine

explanation.surface: A wine-lover, sipping, tries to work out the vineyard of origin.
explanation.definitionFit: To divine something is to guess it by intuition or insight.

clue.text: Nothing found in short river

indicators.note: short means the river's name loses its last letter

parts.note: the Nile is the great river of Egypt

explanation.surface: Nothing turned up in a stunted stream.
explanation.definitionFit: Nil means zero, nothing at all, especially in sports scores.

clue.text: Seize assets, skimming losses in theatre companies

indicators.note: in places the trimmed losses inside the theatre companies

parts.note: reps are repertory theatre companies

indicators.note: skimming takes off the top, removing the first letter of losses

explanation.surface: Bailiffs take property, trimming the debts of struggling theatre companies.
explanation.walkthrough: 'skimming' takes the top letter off LOSSES, giving OSSES, which goes 'in' REPS.
explanation.definitionFit: To repossess is to take back goods or property when payments are not made, seizing assets.

clue.text: Plain fish eating doctor

indicators.note: eating means the fish swallows the doctor, holding it inside

parts.note: the tuna is a large sea fish

explanation.surface: A fish devours a medic, a bizarre scene.
explanation.definitionFit: Tundra is the vast treeless Arctic plain, so a specific kind of plain.

clue.text: Grows love sick — dashed back outside

indicators.note: outside means those letters are placed around the rearranged love
back says the word for hurried is written from end to start

parts.note: dashed means sped, hurried

indicators.note: sick suggests something disordered, so the letters of love are jumbled

explanation.surface: A lovesick person rushes home again, wanting to be outdoors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'love sick' reads as lovesick, but 'sick' rearranges the four letters to EVELO; 'back' turns the hurried word into DEPS, which goes 'outside' them.
explanation.definitionFit: To develop is to grow or mature, a plain synonym in the verb form.

clue.text: Hold in stomach

explanation.surface: Advice to keep one's belly pulled in.
explanation.definitionFit: To bear a weight is to hold it, and to bear something unpleasant is to stomach or tolerate it.

clue.text: Soldiers advanced without being persistent

parts.note: RE, the Royal Engineers, is a British army corps
money advanced is money lent
less means without, as in a pound less tax

explanation.surface: Troops pushed forward without ever letting up.
explanation.definitionFit: Relentless means never easing up, the same as persistent.

clue.text: Tenant does all here for a change

indicators.note: for a change signals that these letters are to be altered into a new order

explanation.surface: A renter does all the work in this place as a novelty.
explanation.definitionFit: A leaseholder occupies property under a lease, which makes them a tenant.

clue.text: In no way corrupt, thus replacing America's expert

indicators.note: replacing tells us one short word is swapped in for another

parts.note: someone in no way corrupt is virtuous
US is the United States, America
so means thus, in that manner

explanation.surface: An expert from the US is honest, so a substitute steps in.
explanation.walkthrough: 'thus replacing America's' puts SO in place of US in VIRTUOUS.
explanation.definitionFit: A virtuoso is a person of outstanding skill, especially in music, so an expert.

clue.text: Bring in worker — it's crucial

parts.note: to import goods is to bring them in from abroad
a worker is the familiar crossword ant, the worker insect

explanation.surface: Hiring a labourer is essential.
explanation.definitionFit: Something important matters greatly, which is what crucial means.

clue.text: Former president's got time to help

parts.note: Abe is Abraham Lincoln, a former US president

explanation.surface: An ex-president has the time to lend a hand.
explanation.definitionFit: To abet is to assist or help, usually in wrongdoing.

clue.text: Alerts flyers covering area with Royal Navy

indicators.note: covering means the flyers' word wraps around the other letters

parts.note: wings are what fly, flyers in a fanciful sense

explanation.surface: Aircraft patrolling a zone with the navy send out alarms.
explanation.definitionFit: Warnings are notices of danger, the same as alerts.

clue.text: Post traumatic situation

indicators.note: traumatic suggests something shaken and disturbed, so the four letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Post-traumatic stress, a familiar phrase.
explanation.walkthrough: The clue reads as the phrase 'post-traumatic', but 'traumatic' is the anagram signal working on POST.
explanation.definitionFit: A spot can mean a situation, especially a difficult one, as in a tight spot.

clue.text: Turn, oddly reluctant to cross

indicators.note: oddly takes the first and third letters of Turn

parts.note: averse means unwilling, reluctant

explanation.surface: A nervous person turns away, unwilling to go across.
explanation.definitionFit: To traverse is to travel across something, so cross as a verb.

clue.text: Scared off by fighting units

indicators.note: off suggests something gone bad or out of order, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Frightened away by soldiers.
explanation.definitionFit: Cadres are small trained groups, especially the core of military units.

clue.text: Tuna scarce? Perhaps — and lobster, for example

indicators.note: perhaps hints that the letters could be arranged in another way

explanation.surface: Fish stocks are low, and shellfish too, a worry about overfishing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Perhaps' signals the anagram of TUNA SCARCE; 'and' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A lobster is one example of a crustacean, the class including crabs and shrimps.

clue.text: Country gent chasing love

indicators.note: chasing means coming behind, so the gent follows love

parts.note: O is love, a zero score in tennis
a gent is a man

explanation.surface: A country gentleman in pursuit of romance.
explanation.definitionFit: Oman is a country on the Arabian Peninsula.

clue.text: Zones covered by care assistants

indicators.note: covered by says the answer lies concealed inside the run of words

explanation.surface: Districts looked after by care workers.
explanation.definitionFit: Areas are regions or zones, a plain synonym.

clue.text: The sort of court one jumps

explanation.surface: A judicial body and something that leaps.
explanation.definitionFit: A kangaroo court is an unofficial mock tribunal, and the kangaroo is the Australian marsupial famous for hopping.

clue.text: Capital preparation for upcoming stage

indicators.note: upcoming in a down answer means the word is read from bottom to top

parts.note: a leg is a stage of a journey or race

explanation.surface: Getting ready for the next phase in the capital city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Capital' means of the head, so a capital preparation is a hair product.
explanation.definitionFit: Gel is a styling product put on the hair, so a preparation for the head.

clue.text: People undressed around midnight get gentle reminders

indicators.note: around says the nudes wrap about the letter from midnight

parts.note: nudes are people with no clothes on
the middle of the word night is the letter G

explanation.surface: Naked folk out at midnight are given polite prompts.
explanation.definitionFit: Nudges are small pushes, figuratively gentle reminders to do something.

clue.text: Hunts for lectures on the origin of space

indicators.note: on here means the lectures come next, after the opening letter
the origin of takes the opening letter of space

parts.note: talks are lectures

explanation.surface: Searches for lectures on how the universe began.
explanation.definitionFit: To stalk is to hunt by following prey stealthily.

clue.text: Pair of diners accentuate suffering

indicators.note: pair of takes the first two letters of diners

parts.note: to stress something is to accentuate it

explanation.surface: Two diners emphasise their pain.
explanation.definitionFit: Distress is pain or anguish, the same as suffering.
